question: How should `/reasoning stream` be presented in the TUI: as a transient chat update, as footer/status text, or only through the existing Show thinking history path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the reporter explicitly asks for OpenAI/Grok-style overwriting and later footer/status placement, so implementing without a maintainer UX choice could cement the wrong TUI contract.

options.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
options.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

options.title: Footer Status Reasoning
options.body: Put the latest reasoning delta in the footer/activity status line, matching the reporter's later request but competing with existing run-state text.

options.title: History Only
options.body: Do not add live TUI reasoning presentation; fix docs/help so users rely on `/reasoning on` plus Show thinking.

recommendation.title: Transient Chat Reasoning
recommendation.body: Render `agent stream=thinking` as a temporary chat entry that updates during the run and clears or collapses when the final answer arrives.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced `/reasoning` visibility and have recent history on the TUI command path, making them the best available owner for the UX contract choice.
